aka.zh: 5 号公路，“常青路线”（劳埃德明斯特至萨斯卡通，1976 年前）
14 号公路（萨斯卡通至马尼托巴省界，1976 年前）

tagline.en: Across Saskatchewan by the northern route: four lanes from Lloydminster to beyond Saskatoon, two lanes past the Quill Lakes to Manitoba
tagline.zh: 沿北线横贯萨斯喀彻温：劳埃德明斯特至萨斯卡通以东为四车道，过羽毛湖至马尼托巴为双车道

start.en: Lloydminster, where Highway 16 meets Highway 17 on the Alberta–Saskatchewan boundary
start.zh: 劳埃德明斯特，16 号公路在阿尔伯塔—萨斯喀彻温省界上与 17 号公路相交

end.en: The Manitoba boundary east of Marchwell, where the road continues as Manitoba Highway 16 towards Russell
end.zh: 马奇韦尔以东的马尼托巴省界，道路由此续为马尼托巴 16 号公路通往拉塞尔

en: Highway 16 crosses Saskatchewan diagonally for about 689 km, from Lloydminster on the Alberta line south-east through North Battleford, Saskatoon and Yorkton to the Manitoba border. It is the province's section of the Yellowhead, the northern Trans-Canada route.

The two halves are different roads. From Lloydminster to just east of Clavet, beyond Saskatoon, it is a four-lane divided highway along the North Saskatchewan River, crossing it on the twin-span Battlefords Bridge and again near Borden; in Saskatoon it is signed around the Circle Drive ring road. From Clavet to Manitoba it is two lanes with passing lanes, through potash and canola country past Lanigan, Big Quill Lake, the largest salt lake in Canada, Wynyard, Foam Lake and Yorkton.

The western half follows the grade of the Canadian Northern Railway and the eastern half that of the Manitoba and North West Railway, later part of the Canadian Pacific. Towns that ended up off the straightened road shrank; the old alignments survive as Highways 16A and 16B and as local roads.
zh: 16 号公路斜穿萨斯喀彻温省约 689 公里，自阿尔伯塔省界上的劳埃德明斯特向东南经北巴特尔福德、萨斯卡通和约克顿，直抵马尼托巴省界。它是黄头公路——北线横加公路——在该省的部分。
前后两半是两种不同的路。劳埃德明斯特至萨斯卡通以东的克拉维特为四车道分隔公路，沿北萨斯喀彻温河而行，经双幅巴特尔福德大桥过河，在博登附近再次过河；在萨斯卡通，它沿环城路“环形大道”标示。克拉维特至马尼托巴为双车道并设有超车道，穿过钾盐与油菜产区，途经拉尼根、加拿大最大的咸水湖大羽毛湖、温亚德、福姆湖和约克顿。
西半段沿加拿大北方铁路的路基修建，东半段沿后来并入加拿大太平洋铁路的马尼托巴与西北铁路的路基修建。被截弯取直的公路甩在一旁的城镇逐渐萎缩；旧线如今成为 16A、16B 号公路和地方道路。

en: Before it was the Yellowhead, the road was two highways. Highway 5, the Evergreen Route, ran from the Alberta border through the Battlefords to Saskatoon; Highway 14 ran from Saskatoon to Manitoba. Gravelling of Highway 14 from Wynyard to Manitoba began in 1930, and the earth road between Lanigan and Saskatoon was started in 1929. A ferry carried Highway 5 across the North Saskatchewan until the Borden Bridge was completed in 1936.

The roads were straightened and widened in the 1950s and 1960s: near Sheho in 1955, past Plunkett and Viscount in 1957, and on the Borden Bridge–Saskatoon cut-off, opened on 20 October 1969. Communities along the route had organised caravans and meetings from November 1947 to press for a northern Trans-Canada route. The Yellowhead was officially opened on 15 August 1970, and in 1976 the whole route in Saskatchewan was renumbered 16.

Twinning followed from the 1990s. The 92 km between Saskatoon and North Battleford, with a new bridge near Borden and a railway underpass, was opened on 8 December 1997 by the provincial highways minister and the federal transport minister. North Battleford to Lloydminster was twinned section by section from 1999, the last 41.6 km between Delmas and Paynton in 2007, and the 1.6 km through Lloydminster along 44th Street in 2008. East of Saskatoon, 19.5 km bypassing Clavet opened in October 2016. There are no plans to twin the rest to Manitoba; instead 26 passing lanes were completed between Clavet and the border in July 2023.
zh: 在成为黄头公路之前，这条路分属两条公路。5 号公路，即“常青路线”，自阿尔伯塔省界经巴特尔福德双城至萨斯卡通；14 号公路自萨斯卡通至马尼托巴。14 号公路温亚德至马尼托巴段于 1930 年开始铺砾石，拉尼根至萨斯卡通的土路于 1929 年开工。5 号公路过北萨斯喀彻温河靠渡船，直到 1936 年博登大桥建成。
20 世纪 50 至 60 年代，道路被截弯取直并加宽：1955 年在希霍附近，1957 年绕过普伦基特和维斯康特，1969 年 10 月 20 日博登大桥至萨斯卡通的捷径通车。自 1947 年 11 月起，沿线社区就组织车队和集会，呼吁修建北线横加公路。黄头公路于 1970 年 8 月 15 日正式开通，1976 年该省境内全线改编为 16 号。

20 世纪 90 年代起开始拓宽为四车道。萨斯卡通至北巴特尔福德的 92 公里，连同博登附近的一座新桥和一处铁路下穿通道，于 1997 年 12 月 8 日由省公路部长与联邦交通部长共同开通。北巴特尔福德至劳埃德明斯特自 1999 年起逐段拓宽，最后的德尔马斯至佩恩顿 41.6 公里于 2007 年完成，穿过劳埃德明斯特市区沿 44 街的 1.6 公里于 2008 年完成。萨斯卡通以东绕过克拉维特的 19.5 公里于 2016 年 10 月通车。其余通往马尼托巴的路段暂无拓宽计划，取而代之的是 2023 年 7 月在克拉维特至省界之间建成的 26 条超车道。

en: The twinning was paid for in pieces, much of it shared with Ottawa. The Saskatoon–North Battleford section cost $42.4 million, of which $36.5 million was split equally under the federal–provincial Strategic Highway Improvement Program. For North Battleford to Lloydminster the province reported spending $110.7 million and the federal government $29.5 million, with Ottawa paying half from 2002–03 under the Canada Strategic Infrastructure Fund and the Strategic Highway Infrastructure Program, which let the province finish three years early.

The Lloydminster section, $11.4 million, was split 75–25 between the province and the city, the provincial share coming from the sale of the NewGrade heavy oil upgrader in Regina. The Clavet bypass was estimated at $52.4 million, $22.8 million of it from the New Building Canada Fund. The 2023 passing lanes, $50 million, were part of the province's pandemic stimulus programme.
zh: 四车道拓宽工程是分段出资的，其中很大一部分与联邦政府分摊。萨斯卡通至北巴特尔福德段造价 4,240 万加元，其中 3,650 万加元由联邦与省政府在“战略公路改善计划”下平均分担。北巴特尔福德至劳埃德明斯特段，省政府报告出资 1.107 亿加元、联邦政府 2,950 万加元；自 2002—03 财年起，联邦政府通过“加拿大战略基础设施基金”和“战略公路基础设施计划”承担一半费用，使该省提前三年完工。
劳埃德明斯特市区段造价 1,140 万加元，由省政府与市政府按 75 比 25 分担，省方资金来自出售里贾纳 NewGrade 重油改质厂的收入。克拉维特绕行段估价 5,240 万加元，其中 2,280 万加元来自“新建设加拿大基金”。2023 年的超车道工程耗资 5,000 万加元，属于该省疫情期间的经济刺激计划。

value.en: 689.2 km, as cited in English Wikipedia, Saskatchewan Highway 16.
value.zh: 689.2 公里，据英文维基百科“萨斯喀彻温 16 号公路”条目。

value.en: No total for the original road. Twinning by section: Saskatoon–North Battleford $42.4 million (1997); Delmas–Paynton $22.1 million (2007); Lloydminster $11.4 million (2008); Clavet bypass $52.4 million estimated (2016). Passing lanes east of Clavet $50 million (2023).
value.zh: 原有道路无总造价。四车道拓宽分段造价：萨斯卡通至北巴特尔福德 4,240 万加元（1997 年）；德尔马斯至佩恩顿 2,210 万加元（2007 年）；劳埃德明斯特市区段 1,140 万加元（2008 年）；克拉维特绕行段估价 5,240 万加元（2016 年）。克拉维特以东超车道 5,000 万加元（2023 年）。

figures.source: Government of Saskatchewan news releases, 8 December 1997, 26 July 2007, 6 August 2008, 21 October 2016 and 27 July 2023

value.en: The province, with federal cost-sharing on the twinning: half of $36.5 million on Saskatoon–North Battleford; $29.5 million against the province's $110.7 million on North Battleford–Lloydminster; $22.8 million on the Clavet bypass. The City of Lloydminster paid $3 million of its section.
value.zh: 省政府出资，四车道拓宽有联邦分担：萨斯卡通至北巴特尔福德段 3,650 万加元的一半；北巴特尔福德至劳埃德明斯特段联邦 2,950 万加元、省 1.107 亿加元；克拉维特绕行段联邦 2,280 万加元。劳埃德明斯特市为市区段出资 300 万加元。

figures.source: Government of Saskatchewan news releases, 8 December 1997, 26 July 2007, 6 August 2008 and 21 October 2016

value.en: About 310 km twinned, from Lloydminster to east of Clavet; 26 passing lanes, typically at least 2 km each, from Clavet to the Manitoba border.
value.zh: 约 310 公里为四车道，自劳埃德明斯特至克拉维特以东；克拉维特至马尼托巴省界设 26 条超车道，每条一般不短于 2 公里。

figures.source: English Wikipedia, Saskatchewan Highway 16; Government of Saskatchewan news release, 27 July 2023

timeline.en: Work starts on Highway 14 between Lanigan and Saskatoon as an earth road.
timeline.zh: 14 号公路拉尼根至萨斯卡通段作为土路开工。

timeline.en: The Borden Bridge replaces the ferry over the North Saskatchewan on Highway 5.
timeline.zh: 博登大桥建成，取代 5 号公路跨越北萨斯喀彻温河的渡船。

timeline.en: The Borden Bridge–Saskatoon cut-off opens on 20 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 20 日，博登大桥至萨斯卡通的捷径通车。

timeline.en: The Yellowhead Highway is officially opened on 15 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 15 日，黄头公路正式开通。

timeline.en: Highways 5 and 14 on the Yellowhead route are renumbered 16.
timeline.zh: 黄头公路沿线的 5 号与 14 号公路改编为 16 号。

timeline.en: Twinning between Saskatoon and North Battleford is completed on 8 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 8 日，萨斯卡通至北巴特尔福德的四车道拓宽完工。

timeline.en: The second span of the Battlefords Bridge opens.
timeline.zh: 巴特尔福德大桥第二幅桥通车。

timeline.en: The last rural gap between North Battleford and Lloydminster, Delmas to Paynton, is twinned.
timeline.zh: 北巴特尔福德至劳埃德明斯特之间最后一段乡村缺口——德尔马斯至佩恩顿——完成拓宽。

timeline.en: Twinned lanes bypassing Clavet, east of Saskatoon, open in October.
timeline.zh: 10 月，萨斯卡通以东绕过克拉维特的四车道通车。

timeline.en: The last of 26 passing lanes between Clavet and Manitoba opens near Saltcoats in July.
timeline.zh: 7 月，克拉维特至马尼托巴之间 26 条超车道中的最后一条在索尔特科茨附近开通。
